label: S2_12_Reajustes
code_lines: /*CALCULO DE REAJUSTES DE INST AF.29 Y AF.42 DE TODOS LOS SECTORES QUE SE IMPUTAN EN CTA YG COMO INTERESES*/
PROC SQL;/*INCOPORA SECTOR DE CONTRAPARTIDA Y SECTOR DETALLADO*/
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN 'H' ELSE 'D' END) AS C_ENTRADA,
FROM 		TABLAS.BD_CTSI t1, TABLAS.T_SECTORIZACION T2, TABLAS.T_CONTRAPARTIDAS T3
WHERE 		(T1.SECTOR=T2.C_SI) AND (T1.C_CAGENTE=T3.C_CAGENTE)AND (T1.C_SCN in ('AF.29','AF.42') AND C_CUENTA='Rec Precio Reaj'
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA, t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,CALCULATED C_SCN, CALCULATED N_SCN, t3.C_SI;
/*CALCULA ESTRUCTURA SIN HOGARES PARA SECTORIZAR REAJUSTES A PAGAR POR FONDOS MUTUOS MOMEY MARKET Y NO MONEY MARKET*/
/*BALANCE DEPÓSITOS FFMM POR SECTOR SIN HOGARES*/
WHERE 		(T1.SECTOR=T2.C_SI) AND (T1.C_SCN in ('AF.521','AF.522') AND C_CUENTA='Bce Final' AND T1.SECTOR IN(3390102,3390101)
AND T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_CAGENTE NOT IN ('511'))
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA, t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_SCN, t1.C_CAGENTE;
PROC SQL;/*BALANCE DEPÓSITOS FFMM TOTAL SIN HOGARES*/
GROUP BY 	T1.MONEDA, t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN;
PROC SQL; /*CALCULA ESTRUCTURA PARA SECTORIZAR REAJUSTES SIN HOGARES*/
FROM 		BCE_DEP_FM T1, BCE_DEP_TOT T2, TABLAS.T_CONTRAPARTIDAS T3
WHERE 		T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM AND T1.SECTOR=T2.SECTOR AND T1.C_CAGENTE=T3.C_CAGENTE
PROC SQL;/*AJUSTE INTERESES PAGADOS EN FFMM MONEY MARKET, TOTAL...A SECTORIZAR*/
'Renta de la inversión atribuida a los accionistas de los fondos de inversión colectiva' AS N_SCN,
WHERE 		(t1.'AÑO'n=t2.'AÑO'n AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM AND T1.SECTOR=T2.SECTOR) AND T1.SECTOR=3390101
GROUP BY 	t1.MONEDA, t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,CALCULATED C_SCN, CALCULATED N_SCN,CALCULATED C_CAGENTE;
PROC SQL;/* REAJUSTES EN FFMM NO MONEY MARKET, TOTAL*/
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN 'H' ELSE 'D' END) AS C_ENTRADA,
'Renta de la inversión atribuida a los accionistas de los fondos de inversión colectiva' AS N_SCN,
WHERE 		(T1.SECTOR=T2.C_SI) AND (T1.C_SCN in ('AF.29','AF.42') AND C_CUENTA='Rec Precio Reaj') AND T1.SECTOR=3390102
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA, t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,t1.SECTOR, CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,CALCULATED C_SCN, CALCULATED N_SCN, t1.C_CAGENTE;
PROC SQL;/*AJUSTE INTERESES PAGADOS EN FFMM NO MONEY MARKET, TOTAL...A SECTORIZAR*/
'Renta de la inversión atribuida a los accionistas de los fondos de inversión colectiva' AS N_SCN,
GROUP BY 	t1.MONEDA, t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,CALCULATED C_SCN, CALCULATED N_SCN,CALCULATED C_CAGENTE;
/*UNE DATOS DE FONDOS MUTUOS CON REAJUSTES QUE PAGAN PARA SECTORIZARLOS*/
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=REAJ_FMMM DATA=D41_FMNM FORCE;RUN;
/*SECTORIZA REAJUSTES PAGADOS POR FFMM DE HOGARES*/
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.REAJUSTES DATA=FM_SECT_HH FORCE;RUN;
CREATE TABLE FM_HH_RESTA AS /*RESTA PORCION DE HOGARES DEL TOTAL*/
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=REAJ_FMMM DATA=FM_HH_RESTA FORCE;RUN;
/*SECTORIZA REAJUSTES PAGADOS POR FFMM SIN HOGARES*/
GROUP BY 	T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T2.C_CAGENTE, T1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA, T1.C_SCN, T1.N_SCN,T1.FUENTE;
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.REAJUSTES DATA=FM_SECT FORCE;RUN;
/*GENERA INTERESES POR REAJUSTES RECIBIDOS POR LOS SECTORES DESDE LOS FONDOS MUTUOS PARA SER IMPUTADOS EN LA CTA YG*/
WHERE 		T1.SECTOR IN (3390101,3390102) AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_CAGENTE NOT IN ('6','3390101','3390102');
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.REAJUSTES DATA=WORK.REAJ_FM_H FORCE;RUN;
/*AJUSTE EN FONDOS DE PENSIONES POR TEMA DE REAJUSTES...SE DEBEN CALZAR PARA NO GENERAR PTMO NETO*/
(CASE WHEN T1.C_SCN in ('D.41','D.443') THEN 'D.44' ELSE T1.C_SCN END) AS C_SCN,
(CASE WHEN T1.C_SCN in ('D.41','D.443') THEN 'Renta de la propiedad atribuida a los titulares de pólizas de seguros' ELSE T1.N_SCN END ) AS N_SCN,
GROUP BY 	t1.MONEDA, t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,CALCULATED C_SCN, CALCULATED N_SCN,CALCULATED C_CAGENTE, t1.C_CUENTA;
